first_correct_rule: Audit and reuse the three committed starts; remaining starts use T0 repeat ascending, then model ascending, without performance selection. Finalize only after both models' baseline cells are terminal.
smoke_gate: All references pass; API identities match; at least one generated program independently passes. Other generation failures remain outcomes.
final_test_policy: Separate external manifests, evaluated only after candidate selection. No API calls and no training export of final-test feedback.
training_export_policy: Retain every returned call and candidate. SFT requires an exact code-hash/cell match to explicit development numerical validation. GRPO exports prompts and outcome evidence; online training needs the executable verifier.
comparison_policy: Equal tested-candidate budgets; provider-specific reasoning settings. Every failure and timeout retained. No pooling with exploratory cohorts.
